name: Regencós (Spain)
description: Red field strewn with white crosses, five of them complete, with a yellow embattled wall across the centre bearing a tower.
history: The flag was approved on 1 September 1999 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2981 of 23 September 1999; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, strewn with white crosses 3/16 of the height, five of them complete, with the wall of the arms.
